programme.desc: Tonight on Upfront in the Prophetic we welcome Dr Kareem Griffith — a pharmacist man of faith and wellness advocate whose life took an unexpected turn after being diagnosed with congestive heart failure In one of the most difficult seasons of his life a dear friend reached out because they genuinely cared about what he was going through That conversation opened the door to a journey that would not only impact his health but also his purpose and outlook on wellness Tonight Dr Griffith shares Why he said “yes” to this company Why a successful pharmacist would even consider becoming involved What the products have personally meant to him The importance of cellular communication and the new acemannan technology The Kingdom-minded mission behind the company The incredible work being done through MannaRelief feeding children in over 90 countries Why this opportunity is for everyday people — not just doctors or medical professionals And how faith played a major role in his decision to become part of this movement This is more than a conversation about products It’s a conversation about purpose compassion restoration and making a difference in people’s lives

programme.title: Jmc Broadcasting - Trumps Economic Revolution The Midterm Showdown | Susan Kokinda
programme.desc:
John Michael Chambers hosts this special broadcast with Susan Kokinda Vice Chair of the Michigan Republican Party and founder of Promethean Action for an in-depth discussion on President Trumps economic and strategic revolution and the critical November 3rd midterm elections
Susan explains that Trump is bringing back the American System of Political Economy — the founding fathers unique economic model based on the productive powers of the human mind not financial speculation She reveals how the British Empire subverted Americas economic independence through the Federal Reserve and the assassination of William McKinley and how Trump is now dismantling that imperial model The administrations tariff policy focus on science and technology and creation of parallel institutions like the Office of Strategic Capital and Export-Import Bank are all pillars of this revolution while Kevin Warsh is clipping the wings of the Federal Reserve by ending forward guidance and shrinking its interventionist footprint

programme.title: 07 21 The Tenpenny Files - The Book of Heaven - Katie Asher
programme.desc: What her son revealed about autism full consciousness and being trapped inside a body that wouldn’t respond He was fully aware the whole time able to hear everything understand everything and feel everything yet he had no way to respond after the shots they were told would protect him Parents have been saying this for years A child develops normally something changes and nothing returns to what it was They try to explain what they saw and are dismissed while their child slips behind a diagnosis that does not match what they experienced Katie Asher is talking about her son Houston and this episode shows what non-speaking autism can look like when awareness is still fully there She watched him lose abilities in real time and saw a clear gap between what she was being told and what was actually happening This is about severe autism where communication is gone but awareness may remain and it brings forward a reality many people have not considered A child can hear you understand you and feel everything around them while having no consistent way to respond That condition reshapes the entire family and changes daily life in ways most people never see Siblings grow up under pressure that is rarely acknowledged and the outside world often assumes something very different from what is happening inside the home Everything changes when communication opens After seventeen years Houston speaks and later he begins communicating through spelling What comes through is direct and consistent He was aware the entire time That does not fit the way most people understand intelligence or the brain Houston then describes awareness that does not depend on his body and expresses understanding that was never directly taught He communicates perception that does not rely on speech or typical interaction Katie Asher explains how this experience changed how she understands consciousness suffering and faith and how it forced her to confront the possibility that awareness is not limited to the body in the way she once believed If this is real it changes how you see every non-speaking child you have ever met

programme.title: JMC Broadcasting - The Tetanus Shot Infertility The mRNA Agenda
programme.desc:
Kristi Leigh sits down with Dr Carrie Madej an osteopathic physician and vaccine researcher who has spent years sounding the alarm on the tetanus shot and its buried connection to a global sterilization agenda Dr Madej exposes the 1972 World Health Organization and NIH research that attached the hCG pregnancy hormone to the tetanus vaccine training the female body to attack early pregnancies without warning She explains why the ten-year booster schedule is no accident and how this eugenics program has been systematically hidden from the public
Dr Madej also pulls back the curtain on the newly approved mRNA flu shot the reality of vaccine shedding and the accelerating push toward transhumanism through AI integration and the Internet of Bodies She lays out practical steps for reclaiming your health from distilled water and slippery elm to detox baths that pull radiation from the body She warns against smartwatches ambient AI in hospitals and the algorithms now assigning value to patients and dictating treatment This is not about fear — it is about awakening action and trusting the God who has already overcome Subscribe and join the monthly Global Defense War military panel

programme.title: Skywatch TV - Jim Bakker HE WARNED US DECADES AGO
programme.desc: Jim Bakker — the pioneer of Christian television who built the PTL Network into one of the largest Christian broadcasting networks in the world and has spent more than six decades proclaiming the gospel — sits down with Joe Ardis Horn and the Skywatch TV team for a deeply personal wide-ranging conversation you wont want to miss Joining Jim are his wife Lori Bakker author of More Than I Could Ever Ask and Mondo De La Vega co-host of The Jim Bakker Show and author of My Crazy Life The Moments That Brought a Gangster to Grace Together they reflect on decades of friendship with the late Dr Tom Horn the faithful legacy he left behind and the miraculous ways God has sustained both the Bakker and Horn ministries through seasons of trial and near collapse Jim opens the Word of God and shares an urgent prophetic message from the Book of Revelation — declaring that we are living in the fulfillment of what Scripture foretold From earthquakes to cultural upheaval from the rapture to the perseverance of the saints this is a conversation for the hour we are in If youve ever wondered what it looks like when God refuses to let a ministry die — this is it
